pageTitle: Klacks for Logistics | Routes, Driving Times & Cross-Border Operations

hero.titleHtml: Routes, driving times, deadlines — all under control.
hero.subtitle: Klacks schedules routes and drivers — with driving and rest times, the right license classes, and cross-border public holidays. Routes are optimized automatically.

challenges.title: Routes, regulations, and deadlines at once

items.title: Routes & deadlines
items.text: Stops, time windows, and distances all have to align — every reschedule has knock-on effects.

items.title: Driving & rest times
items.text: Statutory driving and rest times are mandatory — and nearly impossible to guarantee by hand across many drivers.

items.title: Cross-border
items.text: Different countries, different public holidays and rules: a route crossing the border needs both calendars.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for logistics
solutions.subtitle: From the optimized route to the cross-border public holiday — it all works together.

items.title: Routes optimized automatically
items.text: Klacks sequences stops in the most sensible order — short distances, time windows met, fewer empty runs.

items.title: Driving & rest times checked
items.text: Statutory limits are monitored in real time — violations never happen in the first place.

items.title: Multiple countries & calendars
items.text: Public holidays and rules from multiple countries can be combined — each with its own effect on hours and pay premiums.

items.title: The right license classes
items.text: Klacks assigns routes only to drivers with the right license — and warns before a certification expires.

items.title: Klacksy schedules by voice
items.text: “Schedule tomorrow's routes, driver Meier is out sick” is enough — Klacksy recalculates everything.

items.title: Absences covered fast
items.text: If a driver drops out, Klacks immediately shows who's qualified, available, and within driving-time limits.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your logistics operation
cta.text: In a personal demo, we'll show you how Klacks handles routes, driving times, and drivers for you.
